propositions: The tickets store contains 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics: 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all AUTO-RECOVER LINK type), and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record.

The scoped repair tooling (Gerrit 1391) enables selective repair via `rebar fsck --repair --only=stale-channel` with resumable batching and safety constraints including refusal of mixed-fault tickets.
Live quiet-window execution successfully repaired all 10 orphan events and 550 stale-channel findings through batched commits and pushes, leaving only 4 intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records.
Pre-repair bundle and exact diagnostic manifest verified the baseline state; post-repair fsck confirmed zero repairable findings and exact residual audit records.
Repair must execute before the child ticket 561e reclaim/git-maintenance work within the same maintenance window.
